# Results

Using the simulated data from the methodology chapter, we estimate an ordinary least squares regression of $y$ on $x$.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-ols-results
#| tbl-cap: "OLS regression results for the simulated DGP"
#| echo: true

X = np.column_stack([np.ones(n), x])
k = X.shape[1]

beta_hat = np.linalg.inv(X.T @ X) @ (X.T @ y)
y_hat = X @ beta_hat
residuals = y - y_hat

sigma2_hat = (residuals @ residuals) / (n - k)
vcov_hat = sigma2_hat * np.linalg.inv(X.T @ X)
se_beta = np.sqrt(np.diag(vcov_hat))
t_stats = beta_hat / se_beta

r2 = 1 - (residuals @ residuals) / np.sum((y - y.mean()) ** 2)

results_table = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "Coefficient": ["Intercept", "x"],
        "Estimate": beta_hat,
        "Std. Error": se_beta,
        "t-Statistic": t_stats,
    }
)

results_table
```

Model fit summary: $R^2$ is printed below.

```{python}
#| echo: false

print(f"R-squared: {r2:.3f}")
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-regression-fit
#| fig-cap: "Linear regression fit on simulated DGP data"
#| echo: true

plt.figure(figsize=(7, 4.5))
plt.scatter(x, y, alpha=0.7, label="Simulated observations")

order = np.argsort(x)
plt.plot(
    x[order],
    y_hat[order],
    color="crimson",
    linewidth=2.0,
    label="Fitted line",
)

plt.xlabel("x")
plt.ylabel("y")
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
